README.md:3:This folder holds the platform team's decisions (`adr/`), runbooks, changelogs, meeting notes, specs, onboarding material and postmortems. Start with `onboarding/first-week.md`.
runbooks/on-call.md:15:The weekly handover is Monday 10:00 UTC. The outgoing on-call posts open incidents, silenced alerts and their expiry, and any flag that was flipped during the week.
runbooks/deploy.md:7:1. Merge to `main`; CI builds the image and pushes `api:<sha>`.
runbooks/database-failover.md:11:3. Announce in #incidents and open a follow-up to rebuild the old primary as a replica.
runbooks/database-failover.md:15:The old primary must be rebuilt from a fresh base backup before it rejoins; reusing its data directory caused the split-brain incident of 2024-11-08.
specs/payments-sepa.md:13:SEPA is behind `payments.sepa` in the config service. It must default to its last known value, not to off (incident 2026-06-12).
specs/selective-ci.md:1:# Selective CI builds
specs/selective-ci.md:13:Behind the `ci-selective` flag for two weeks, comparing skipped jobs against the full build. Owner: Lena.
changelog/2025.md:6:- Feature flags gained expiry dates and the `flags-audit` CI job.
adr/0002-blue-green-deploys.md:8:Rolling deploys of the API tier caused two incidents in February 2025 when a bad build served traffic for eleven minutes before the rollout finished. Health checks pass for a process that returns 500 on one endpoint.
adr/0002-blue-green-deploys.md:10:## Decision
adr/0002-blue-green-deploys.md:17:- Negative: double the API capacity for 30 minutes after every release, about $340 per month.
adr/0005-feature-flags.md:10:## Decision
adr/0005-feature-flags.md:12:Flags are read from the config service with a 10-second cache. Every flag has an owner, a description and an expiry date; the CI job `flags-audit` fails when a flag is past its expiry.
adr/0001-postgres-over-mysql.md:10:## Decision
adr/0009-split-workers-repo.md:8:The workers team ships on a different cadence and their Python toolchain doubled the monorepo's CI time. Shared types are now published as a versioned package, which removes the drift problem ADR 0004 solved.
adr/0009-split-workers-repo.md:10:## Decision
adr/0009-split-workers-repo.md:16:- Positive: monorepo CI drops from 18 to 7 minutes.
adr/0004-monorepo.md:8:Three repositories meant three CI pipelines and a release train that took a week to coordinate. Shared types drifted between the API and the web client twice in October 2023.
adr/0004-monorepo.md:10:## Decision
adr/0004-monorepo.md:12:The web client, the API and the background workers move into one repository with a single CI pipeline and a shared `packages/types` module.
adr/0004-monorepo.md:17:- Negative: CI runs take 18 minutes end to end; selective builds are a follow-up.
adr/0003-drop-redis-sessions.md:10:## Decision

# Platform sync — 2026-09-01

- Selective CI: dependency graph done; job skipping in review. Web-only change builds in 6 minutes today, target is 4.
- Search index rewrite: proposal accepted on 2026-08-25; implementation starts after the SEPA follow-ups close.

## Decisions

- The read-only MySQL instance is switched off on 2026-09-15. Its last backup is kept for one year.
